title.narrative: Family Foundation Enhancing Community GBV Prevention Response in Hhohho Region

description.narrative: Women Unlimited will target hot spot communities within the Hhohho Region for awareness and empowerment on GBV prevention, and mental health awareness at the Family/Community level. They will offer mobile counselling and psychosocial support to address family conflicts, mental health issues, and GBV-related trauma, and educate men and families on ending VAWG. Empirical evidence points to strong linkages between mental health, family conflict and VAWG. The May 2024 statistics also indicated that emotional abuse remains the highest (44%), followed by sexual abuse (20%) and other forms. They will engage communities through dialogues and community indabas on the following key strategies: • Community Dialogues & Workshops: Hosting community level dialogues to raise awareness on VAWG, mental health and positive masculinity. Dialogues will encourage creative problem-solving and collaboration among community members. Dialogues will also run throughout the 16 days of activism against VAWG. • Mobile Counselling & Psychosocial Support • Media Campaign: Develop digital materials • Partnerships with Stakeholders: Collaborating with other stakeholders in the GBV space on outreach and services to communities on a road show during the 16 days of activism.
